quizDraft.title: Add inner space to the main content box
quizDraft.prompt:
## CSS task

The Module 1 styling is consistent, but main content still sits too close to its own edges. Padding creates breathing room inside the content box without pushing neighboring boxes away. Start from the exact Module 1 checkpoint. In `styles.css`, add `main { padding: 1.5rem; }`. Keep every earlier selector and declaration. Preview several pages: main content should feel less cramped while its outer position stays otherwise unchanged.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
quizDraft.hint: Think inside the main box rather than outside it.

help.concept: Padding creates breathing room inside the content box without pushing neighboring boxes away.
help.hint_1: Think inside the main box rather than outside it.
help.hint_2: Preview several pages: main content should feel less cramped while its outer position stays otherwise unchanged.

quizDraft.title: Reveal section box edges with a border
quizDraft.prompt:
## CSS task

The semantic content sections blend into the page because their box edges are invisible. A `border` makes the box boundary visible, which helps you see exactly where later `padding` and `margin` act. Keep the cumulative stylesheet and add `section { border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; }`. Preview existing semantic sections without adding wrappers. Check pages with sections: each existing section should gain a subtle `outline` without adding any wrapper HTML.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
quizDraft.hint: Style the existing section boxes directly.

help.concept: A `border` makes the box boundary visible, which helps you see exactly where later `padding` and `margin` act.
help.hint_1: Style the existing section boxes directly.
help.hint_2: Check pages with sections: each existing section should gain a subtle `outline` without adding any wrapper HTML.

quizDraft.title: Separate the footer with outside space
quizDraft.prompt:
## CSS task

The footer still crowds the content above it even though the content boxes themselves are clearer. Margin creates separation outside the footer box, unlike `padding` which would only add space inside it. Keep all previous CSS and add `footer { margin-top: 2rem; }`. The space should be outside the footer's box. Preview the bottom of several pages: there should be a clear `gap` before the footer while the footer's internal size stays the same.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
quizDraft.hint: Choose the spacing property that lives outside the element's `border`.

help.concept: Margin creates separation outside the footer box, unlike `padding` which would only add space inside it.
help.hint_1: Choose the spacing property that lives outside the element's `border`.
help.hint_2: Preview the bottom of several pages: there should be a clear `gap` before the footer while the footer's internal size stays the same.
